source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
In the Fight phase, a unit that has been **eligible to fight** in this phase can move up to 3" under the Moving rules (03). Before moving, it must take the first mode that applies:

- **Ongoing Consolidation**, if the unit is **engaged**: pick every enemy unit engaged with it. Models already in base-to-base contact with an enemy model stay put; each model that moves finishes nearer the nearest picked unit, engaged with it where it can. Afterwards, every model that began the move in engagement with some enemy unit ends it still engaged with that same unit.
- **Engaging Consolidation**, otherwise if any enemy unit is within 3": pick 1 or more such units. Each model that moves finishes nearer the nearest picked unit, engaged with it where it can. Afterwards the unit is engaged with all picked units; then the opponent picks, one by one, each enemy unit engaged with it not yet chosen to fight this phase, each becoming eligible to fight and being chosen to fight under 12.04.
- **Objective Consolidation**, otherwise if any objective is within 3": pick 1. Each model that moves finishes in range of it if it can, or else nearer to it. Afterwards the unit is **unengaged** and in range of that objective.
